ruleset.name: PC2
ruleset.description: PSR-12 for PascalCase class files under src/. Line endings stay out: .gitattributes does not pin *.php, and Windows checkouts are CRLF. Line length stays out: class size is already gated by bin/check-max-lines.php and PHPMD. ClassFileFilter skips lowercase template filenames. PHPCS exclude-pattern is case-insensitive, so it cannot do that split.
